rules.text: Duo Tall Storage (junction-attached, with leg) is offered 54"W, 66"W, 78"W at 15"H (specify p680). Duo Tall and Slim Storage for Answer top cap mounted storage: Tall Individual, Tall Shared, Slim in 54"W and 66"W (specify p681).
Duo tall storage attaches to Answer in-line, L, T, and end-of-run junctions.
Duo tall and slim storage can attach to the top of Answer panels with thin trim; attachment brackets and trims are sold separately.

Tall storage interior: Individual box has a ledge on one side and binder storage on the opposite side; Shared box is divided down the center with half ledge and half binder storage on each side. 66"W and 78"W individual boxes have a center divider on the binder storage side.
Tall storage leg column height at shortest level is 29 7/8"H and adjusts upward 3" for leveling; height from floor to top of box is approximately 45".
Duo Tall Storage attaches perpendicular (90°) to Answer panel at in-line, end-of-run, L or T junction; works with 42"H or taller panels only; attaches on-module only.

Panel-mounted worksurfaces are required when connecting Duo Tall Storage to Answer panels at an in-line, L, T, or end-of-run junction. Worksurface brackets are included to attach to Duo Tall Storage worksurfaces to improve stability.
When mounting Duo Tall or Slim Storage on top of an Answer panel, top cap mounting brackets and additional panel top caps must be specified separately (page 388).
In seismic zones 3 and 4, consult with local building code officials for specific code requirements.
Duo surface materials: box laminate; interior divider cover paint; brackets and leg 4799 Platinum paint.
Duo Tall Storage cannot be mounted off-module.
Panel run with Duo Tall Storage: 42"H minimum panel height; run length 4' minimum, 18' maximum.
A minimum 30"W Answer panel return at 90° or 36"W at 120° must be used with Duo Tall Storage (end-of-run example). Other example: minimum 30"W Answer panel return at 90° or 120°.
If Duo Tall Storage is mounted in an end-of-run application, a 30"W minimum panel return must be used on the other end of the run.
A 30"W minimum panel return is required when Duo Tall Storage is used on a panel that is supporting additional components (run shown 12' maximum).
Seismic zones: follow traditional planning guidelines; Tall Storage leg base must be bolted to the floor per local building code; worksurface brackets included must be installed.
Answer panels with Duo Overhead or Slim Storage on Post and Beam fence: 78"H maximum; fence segment 4'-10' maximum; a minimum 18"W return is required, or a post with large base bolted to the floor.
On a single Post and Beam fence, no more than one Overhead or Slim Storage box can be attached.
Fences with Overhead or Slim Storage spaced no more than 10' apart can stabilize a wall; spaced no more than 8' apart can stabilize a wall with upper storage.
For individual tall storage, only the external side of the interior divider cover has the option to be painted.
Mobile unit has three openings; freestanding unit has four or five openings; eight insert options are available for the openings (English, Spanish, and French wording).
Mobile unit receptacles hold 12 gallons each; freestanding unit receptacles accommodate 30 gallon size bags and larger (23 gallon capacity each per p686).
Tray shelf and display can only be used with the freestanding unit (not the mobile unit).

Freestanding four- or five-slot opening will accommodate two tray shelves (15" gap between on a five-opening unit) or two displays (18 1/2" gap on a five-opening unit); one tray shelf and one display can be used on the freestanding unit.
Tray maximum capacity is 20 food trays with maximum tray size 20" x 20"; tray shelf fits most trays up to 20 3/4" x 12".
Mobile unit: four non-locking concealed casters (two swivel, two fixed), hinged doors on back. Freestanding unit: hinged doors on front, leveling glides fully adjustable to 1 1/2".
Victor2 surface materials: top and sides paint; back and front wood, laminate (HPL), or Customiz stain (option on wood).

Mobile unit requires selection of three acrylic inserts; freestanding units require four or five (one per opening). Insert choices: MIXED Plastic, COMPOST Compost, MIXED Mixed, WASTE Waste, PAPER Paper, RETURNABLE Aluminum, RETURNABLE Returnables, RETURNABLE Glass.
Shelf lights are UL and CSA listed. Local electrical codes vary; consult a qualified electrical contractor or engineer.

Standard shelf light: universal mounting package standard; flush mount and competitive mounting package optional; 3500K; faceted white reflector with rotatable contrast sleeve; electronic high power factor ballast; no electronic dimmer; no lens options; 20,000 hr lamp life; warranty ballast 5 yrs, fixture 12 yrs.

Utility2 shelf light: universal and flush mounting package standard; 3500K; silver reflector, prismatic lens; electronic high power factor or normal-power-factor ballast; no dimmer; batwing lens option; 20,000 hr; warranty ballast 5 yrs, fixture 12 yrs.

Underline and Bottomline: universal spring bracket for recessed mount or screw-in for flush mount (tool free clips for New York). Finish options paint 0835 Black, 7018 Pewter, 7021 Dark Champagne. Electronic dimmer available on Underline only (dimming 100% to 50%); Bottomline not available. Lamp life Underline 10,000 hrs, Bottomline 20,000 hrs.

LED shelf light: magnetic mount for steel bins and shelves standard; optional fastener kit for wood and aluminum shelves. Bottom surface clear anodized aluminum only; plastic cover 6009 Arctic White or 6000 Black. 11 watts; dimming standard; 50,000 hrs; warranty power supply 5 yrs, fixture 12 yrs.

LED personal task light: rail-mounted version attaches to rail systems in c:scape, FrameOne, Elective Elements, Impact, Turnstone Campfire Big Table, and Details SOTO Rail; non rail-mounted version attaches to most freestanding desks and tables. Finish: fixture and stanchions paint 4799 Platinum Metallic, 4231 Arctic White, 4710 Low Gloss Black; plastic cover 6009 Arctic White only. 14 watts; 50,000 hrs.
Non rail-mounted LED personal task lights will not work on worksurfaces with knife edge longer than 1 1/4", or with modesty panels or modesty screens closer than 6" from the back edge.

Standard/Utility2: 9' cord is maximum allowed by U.S. National Electrical Code; cord with circuit breaker available to meet Chicago code. On-off switch centered on front edge (Standard) / right-hand side (Utility2). Cord exits center back (Standard) / right-hand side (Utility2).

Daisy chain starter cord must be ordered separately when Standard shelf lights are used in a daisy chain; daisy chain starter light with cord must be ordered when Utility2 shelf lights are used in a daisy chain. 78" daisy chain jumper cord is standard with select Utility2 lights.
Power drawn is approximately 1/2 amp. Daisy chaining permits interconnecting up to six Standard shelf lights from a single power outlet; Utility2 daisy chaining allows up to 10 fixtures.

Keyhole slots allow mounting beneath wood or laminate overhead storage bins and shelves with screws provided, and to overhead storage manufactured prior to August 1991. Standard shelf competitive mounting package provides hardware to mount on all major competitive furniture lines.

Normal-power-factor electronic ballasts are available on Utility2 shelf lights only; electronic high-power-factor ballast is roughly 45% more efficient and is available on Standard and Utility2. Batwing lens is an option on Utility2.
Shelf light can be mounted anywhere from side to side beneath overhead storage bin or shelf; cord length is the only limitation.
Standard/Utility2 surface materials: housing black paint (standard) or paint colors (option); reflector white on Standard, silver on Utility2; cord and end cap cord manager black plastic only.
Underline/Bottomline: daisy chaining permits interconnecting up to six shelf lights from a single power outlet; power drawn approximately 1/2 amp.

LED daisy chain starter light includes lamp and larger 60 watt power supply to support up to three lights; daisy chain secondary light includes lamp and daisy chain cord set (no power supply). LED standard light uses a 15 watt power supply, 9' long with two prong driver plug.
Daisy chaining is not allowed in Chicago.
Standard shelf lights: starter cord is required with daisy chain cords to bring power to the first shelf light in a daisy chain. Power is not interrupted if a light is off or its lamp burned out.

Utility2 lights: connect power cord between first light and wall receptacle and jumper cord between lights; maximum distance between receptacles for 78" jumper is 74"; connect up to 10 fixtures maximum; fixture rating 120 volt, .75 amps; starter light required with daisy chain lights.
Bottomline lights: starter light is required with daisy chain lights to bring power to the first light in the daisy chain.

Overhead cabinets and shelves provide a recessed area for shelf lights but are not designed to conceal cords when daisy chaining. When using upmount brackets with overhead storage and daisy chaining lights, use the open design upmount bracket for better cord management.

Underline lights: starter cord is required to bring power to the first shelf light; jumper cord is required to connect daisy chain lights; additions to a chain are possible at any time by adding a jumper cord.
Daisy chain starter cords LS1FSC/LS6FSC: use with Standard shelf light only; do not order with Utility2.

Utility2: minimum of two fixtures for daisy chaining and maximum of 10; when ordering starter light do not order a daisy chain starter cord; N lights = 1 starter light + (N-1) daisy chain lights with jumper cord.
Underline: order one daisy chain jumper cord (LTJUMP/LTJUMP3) between fixtures and one starter cord (LTSTART); cords must be used with LT2Y or LT2DY daisy chain lights.

Bottomline: daisy chaining minimum of two fixtures, maximum of six; N lights = 1 starter fixture (L5xFTS) + (N-1) daisy chain fixtures (L5xFTY); when ordering the daisy chain starter you do NOT need to order a starter cord or jumper cord.
LED shelf lights: maximum number of lights that can be daisy chained is three.
Shelf light housing standard black; other paint colors +$23; if an optional paint color is selected, electrical switches and end caps remain black plastic.

Vertical wire manager snaps into the slotted channel of the junction; for use between bottom of a shelf/overhead bin and worksurface or below the worksurface; can be cut in the field; cords/cables can route from the wire manager and the 1/2" gap along the back edge of the worksurface.
Transitional Answer fixed and mobile pedestals are established products intended for customers with existing standards; Universal pedestals and lateral files are recommended for new customers.
Individual locking drawers (+$122) are available on file/file pedestals only.
Fixed pedestal full drawer interiors option (+$49) applies to 24"D and 30"D box/box/file pedestals.
Mobile pedestal full drawer interiors option (+$49) applies to 24"D box/file and box/box/file pedestals.
Cushion top (factory installation) and field-installed cushion tops (RPXTC24P, RPXTCH24P) are for TU7MOBILE only.
Mobile pedestal standard 1/8"H steel top is non-structural.
